3. The Petitioners are accused in C.T. Case No.749 of 2023 pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M.,
Bhubaneswar, arising out of Cyber Crime & Economic P.S. Case No.44 of 2023 for commission of the alleged offence under Sections 419/420/467/468/34 IPC.
4.

entities.text: Cyber Crime & Economic P.S. Case No.44 of 2023
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Special Judge (CBI) Court No.- I-cum-Addl. Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar by order, dated 11.07.2023, 11.10.2023 and 25.07.2023 respectively in the aforementioned cases, the present bail applications have been filed.

entities.text: Special Judge (CBI) Court No.- I-cum-Addl. Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner in BLAPL No.7933 of 2023 is in custody since 1.7.2023, Petitioner in BLAPL No.12178 of 2023 is in custody since 24.06.2023 and the Petitioner in BLAPL No.9818 of 2023 is in custody since 28.06.2023.
6.

It is further submitted that since charge sheet has already been filed on 25.09.2023 and the co-accused have been released on bail by this Court by order dated 18.10.2023 in BLAPL No.9034 of 2023 (Sapan Kumar Dalei) and by order dated 09.11.2023 in BLAPL No.9262 of 2023 (Viveka Nanda Mallick), the Petitioners may be released, inter alia, on the ground of parity.
7.
It is stated that the Petitioners are the first offenders.

8. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer, inter alia, on the ground that further investigation is continuing and since it is an economic offence, no leniency ought to be shown to the Petitioners merely because final form has been submitted.

9. Taking into account the role ascribed to the Petitioners and keeping in view the doctrine of parity as held by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vrs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, (2022) 10 SCC 51, this Court directs the Petitioners to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin subject to verification of criminal antecedent of any nature.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vrs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 10. If it comes to fore that the Petitioners have any criminal antecedent, this order shall not be given effect to.

11. So far as Petitioner (Anil Hembram) in BLAPL No.12178 of 2023 is concerned, he is directed to furnish unencumbered property security to the tune of Rs.5 lakhs to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin and the same shall be abide by the result of the lis.

12. Since further investigation is continuing in the case at hand and keeping in view the specialized investigation, it is directed that the Petitioners shall cooperate with the investigation and shall appear before the I.O as and when summoned.
It shall be open to the prosecution to seek variance of the order, if the Petitioners do not extend the desired cooperation.
13. Accordingly, the bail applications stand disposed of.
